given: a stock row whose inventory_code is a conforming location-batch-serial code (for example "A12-B7-S001")
when: the expand migration adds batch_number and serial_number and backfills them by splitting the code on "-"
then: that row's batch_number equals the second segment ("B7") and serial_number equals the third segment ("S001")
architectural_notes: Infra: the expand Alembic migration (migrations/versions/) adds nullable batch_number+serial_number to the pre-existing stock_records table and backfills them by splitting inventory_code on '-' (segment 2->batch, segment 3->serial). Nullable columns declared on the stock model in app/models/; verified as a real-branch integration test against the paired Lakebase branch. This backfill assertion runs against the shared post-migration verify DB (non-schema-mutating), distinct from the reversibility round-trip (PI1) which mutates schema and runs isolated on its own ephemeral migration-marked branch.
